agent.system_prompt: Solve the task from its input artifacts. Choose tools dynamically as needed, without a prescribed call sequence. Return one JSON object with the requested fields; represent money as two-decimal strings. Do not invent missing facts.

tool_schemas.name: image_preprocess
tool_schemas.description: Apply configurable preprocessing operations to a local image.

tool_schemas.name: ocr
tool_schemas.description: Extract text from a local invoice image. Planned Milestone 4.2 contract.

tool_schemas.name: pdf_parse
tool_schemas.description: Extract all page text from a local PDF. Planned Milestone 4.2 contract.

tasks.goal: Read the invoice image; preprocess if needed. Return invoice_id, total, currency.

scoring_rule.name: exact_fields
scoring_rule.description: Score in [0,1] = correctly matched reference fields / number of reference fields. Parse final answer as one JSON object; strings are stripped of surrounding whitespace and compared case-sensitively; booleans must match in type and value; monetary values use two-decimal strings. Missing/wrong fields score zero; extra fields are ignored. Invalid JSON, failed runs, empty answers and timeouts score zero.
